case_title: Sachidanand Thakur v. Union of India & Ors.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 and sentenced to life imprisonment
offence_finally_established: Murder under Section 302 of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, an army personnel, was on security duty with two other sentries. An incident of stone throwing occurred, and a Quick Reaction Team was summoned. The accused chased a member of the Quick Reaction Team, who was warned not to fire. Despite the warning, the accused fired three shots from a distance of 8 to 10 feet, killing the victim. The weapon used matched the one issued to the accused, and the cartridge cases found at the scene were consistent with the weapon. The accused was apprehended and stated that he did what he had to do.
